proposals.title: Glove wrist seam contact highlight
proposals.change: Add one narrow light-value seam accent where the glove cuff meets the rifle-side wrist.
proposals.implementation_notes: Place a thin strip at x>=bx+3 relative to the ADS weapon assembly; keep it low contrast and preserve the existing unlit HF checker/stripe material on all rifle surfaces.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: Tiny localized accent behind the wall plane with no change to protected cameras or HF base materials.
proposals.acceptance_test: ADS and Cockpit remain usable; glove-to-rifle contact reads at capture distance; HF checkers and stripes remain visible and unchanged.

proposals.title: Trigger finger contact pad
proposals.change: Add a small light-value contact patch on the glove index fingertip where it meets the trigger guard.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use a very low-intensity warm additive proxy, limited to the fingertip silhouette and not the trigger or guard surface.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: Small additive proxy affects only the local glove contact and cannot overwrite ADS HF stripes.
proposals.acceptance_test: Trigger-hand contact is readable without a bright bloom halo; ADS HF checker/stripe coverage is intact.

proposals.title: Glove knuckle ridge cue
proposals.change: Add one thin highlight ridge across the front glove knuckles to separate the hand silhouette from the receiver.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use a single narrow strip following the existing knuckle contour, with subdued off-white value and no new shadow caster.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: Localized behind-wall geometry adds only a silhouette cue and leaves the HF weapon treatment untouched.
proposals.acceptance_test: Knuckle contour separates from the rifle in ADS; no clipping appears during the locked capture pose.

proposals.title: Receiver witness line
proposals.change: Add one short horizontal witness line on the rifle receiver to clarify receiver orientation during ADS.
proposals.implementation_notes: Keep the line thinner than the existing HF checker cells and use restrained amber-white additive intensity.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: A single small emissive mark improves local structure without introducing a solid dark FOV material.
proposals.acceptance_test: Receiver direction is immediately readable; line does not merge with the HF stripes or produce bloom clipping.

proposals.title: Ejection port edge cue
proposals.change: Add a thin light edge around the visible ejection-port opening on the rifle ADS proxy.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use one narrow rectangular accent only on the visible rim; do not fill the port with dark material.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The accent is a small behind-wall rim and preserves the bright unlit HF field around it.
proposals.acceptance_test: Port reads as a recessed rifle feature without a black rectangle; ADS remains usable and HF patterns are preserved.

proposals.title: Charging-handle tab glint
proposals.change: Add a tiny emissive glint to the visible charging-handle tab.
proposals.implementation_notes: Limit the proxy to the tab face, use low-intensity cool white, and disable bloom contribution if the renderer permits.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: Single-pixel-scale additive detail gives a stable landmark without changing the HF base pass.
proposals.acceptance_test: Charging handle is distinguishable in ADS at capture resolution; no starburst or washout is visible.

proposals.title: Magazine-catch pin marker
proposals.change: Add one small circular highlight on the visible magazine-catch pin.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use a tiny raised disc with medium-light neutral value; keep it inside the weapon silhouette and behind the wall plane.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: Tiny local geometry has negligible screen area and no impact on city, ocean, wide, or beauty framing.
proposals.acceptance_test: Pin is readable as a mechanical feature without looking like a muzzle flash or indicator light.

proposals.title: Rear iron-sight notch highlight
proposals.change: Add a thin pale accent to the rear iron-sight notch edges for alignment readability.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use two short low-intensity emissive strokes following the notch shoulders; do not fill the sight aperture.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: Small additive sight accents improve alignment while retaining the open notch and all ADS HF stripes.
proposals.acceptance_test: Rear sight notch remains open and aligns cleanly with the front post; no bloom obscures the aperture.

proposals.title: Front post cap cue
proposals.change: Add a small light-value cap to the top edge of the front iron-sight post.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use a short horizontal cap only at the post tip, with a neutral value distinct from the receiver.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: A tiny behind-wall sight marker adds a stable front-post landmark without material replacement.
proposals.acceptance_test: Front post is legible against the background and remains thinner than the existing HF checker pattern.

proposals.title: Barrel muzzle ring cue
proposals.change: Add one narrow emissive ring at the visible barrel muzzle to establish the bore direction.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use a thin muted orange-white ring with no particle system and no flash-shaped volume.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The additive proxy is small and static, with no effect on the protected scene cameras.
proposals.acceptance_test: Muzzle direction reads at a glance; ring stays crisp and does not resemble an impact ember or bloom washout.

proposals.title: Barrel vent notch
proposals.change: Add one small light edge to the visible barrel vent notch behind the muzzle.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use a single short rectangular accent on the vent rim; avoid filling the cavity with a dark solid.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: A single behind-wall notch is below the scale of the existing HF densify and leaves all stripes intact.
proposals.acceptance_test: Barrel vent reads as a manufactured cue without becoming a black patch or reducing ADS usability.

proposals.title: Igla body identification band
proposals.change: Add one thin high-contrast identification band around the Igla body proxy.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use a narrow desaturated safety-orange band placed behind the wall plane, sized only for silhouette recognition.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The band is a small local cue and does not replace any rifle HF checker/stripe surface.
proposals.acceptance_test: Igla reads as a separate launcher-like object from the rifle; band does not dominate the sight picture.

proposals.title: Igla seeker collar ring
proposals.change: Add a thin pale ring around the Igla seeker collar to clarify its front end.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use a low-intensity cool-white additive ring constrained to the collar circumference; avoid a glowing lens disk.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: Small additive geometry improves Igla orientation without adding a large hero stack or dark material.
proposals.acceptance_test: Igla nose direction is readable while the seeker center remains non-glowing and unclipped.

proposals.title: Igla grip stripe
proposals.change: Add one short light stripe along the visible Igla grip to separate grip from body.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use one narrow angled stripe following the grip axis; keep it thinner than the base HF checker cells.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: Localized behind-wall detail adds Igla readability without touching other stages or the HF treatment.
proposals.acceptance_test: Grip and body separation is visible at ADS capture resolution; no stripe becomes a solid panel.

proposals.title: Igla status point
proposals.change: Add one tiny dim additive status point on the Igla rear housing.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use a single low-intensity cyan-white point with a fixed small radius and no Niagara dependency.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: A single restrained point is capture-stable and cannot replace or cover the unlit HF pattern.
proposals.acceptance_test: Status point is visible but not mistaken for a muzzle flash, impact ember, or scene light source.

proposals.title: Glove palm-to-grip contact strip
proposals.change: Add one narrow contact strip where the glove palm wraps the rifle grip.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use a dim warm additive strip following the palm contact arc; keep it discontinuous so it reads as contact, not a glowing grip.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: Small additive contact geometry is confined to the weapon-hand junction and preserves all HF surfaces.
proposals.acceptance_test: Palm wrap and grip relationship reads clearly; strip does not spill onto the receiver or trigger area.

proposals.title: Cheek-weld glove edge
proposals.change: Add a short edge accent where the glove-side support hand meets the rifle stock or cheek-weld region.
proposals.implementation_notes: Place one small curved strip at x>=bx+3; keep it on the contact boundary and avoid adding a broad stock panel.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: Thin behind-wall contact geometry improves pose readability with negligible screen coverage.
proposals.acceptance_test: Support-hand contact reads as intentional; Cockpit and ADS stay usable with no new dark mass.

proposals.title: Sling-mount witness dot
proposals.change: Add one tiny light witness dot at the visible rifle sling-mount pivot.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use a small circular marker centered on the existing pivot and keep it neutral rather than emissive-bright.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The marker is a single small mechanical cue behind the wall plane and does not affect HF densify coverage.
proposals.acceptance_test: Sling-mount location is recognizable without introducing a distracting bright point.

proposals.title: Iron-sight alignment tick
proposals.change: Add one short alignment tick on the rifle top rail directly behind the rear iron sight.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use a single dim amber-white tick centered on the weapon axis; keep it shorter than the sight notch width.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: Small additive axis cue supports sight alignment while leaving the checker/stripe HF field visible around it.
proposals.acceptance_test: Tick, rear notch, and front post form a clean visual axis; no bloom obscures sight geometry.

proposals.title: Glove thumb contact crescent
proposals.change: Add one small crescent highlight at the glove thumb contact point on the rifle receiver.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use a single curved accent at x>=bx+3 with a restrained neutral value; do not add a full glove decal or receiver patch.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: Tiny local contact detail is capture-safe, keeps the ADS HF base intact, and has no footprint in protected framing.
proposals.acceptance_test: Thumb placement is readable in the locked ADS pose; crescent does not merge into a checker stripe or create clipping.
